case_role: Separate ordinary Fixed and genuinely partial Displacement support benchmark; not a repair of prior witnesses.

geometry.continuum_interfaces: Shared conforming CAD/Gmsh topology; no added interface constraint, Tie, connector or material discontinuity.
geometry.moving_A_receiving_region: Union of all three coplanar finite x10 face patches, total area4mm2, centroid(10,2,3).
geometry.moving_B_receiving_region: Original finite x20 face, area4mm2, centroid(20,2,3).
geometry.CutARight: Union of three x5 faces, outward negativeX, owner union all three A cells x5..10.
geometry.CutBLeft: Original x25 face, outward positiveX, owner B cell x20..25.

ordinary_external_supports.unrestrained_gap: x0,y1.75..2.25,z2..4; width0.5mm, area1mm2. The two support patches do not share an edge, vertex or selected mesh node.
ordinary_external_supports.stability_argument: A rigid motion vanishing on the finite FixedPatch vanishes at at least three non-collinear points; their pairwise differences force all rotation components to zero, and then translation is zero. Thus all six A rigid modes are removed without any auxiliary rigid body or stiffness. All six strictly positive inter-port scalar connector modes stabilize B relative to A. The partial axial support acts on distinct physical nodes; no DOF is prescribed twice.
ordinary_external_supports.all_ordinary_restrained_nodes_outside_cu: Both selected support regions have original x=0; CutARight owner has x5..10, and CutBLeft owner has x20..25.
ordinary_external_supports.individual_patch_reaction_targets: Deliberately unspecified. Distribution depends on the solid response. Require observed nonzero partial axial reaction only as a qualitative participation duty; never fit or prescribe its magnitude.

unchanged_material_and_connectors.attachment: Two native free/moving finite receiving-face RBE ports. No external-support RBE exists.

fixed_acceptance.nonzero_denominator: Norm of the corresponding frozen independent reference vector, assessed separately for force and moment.

first_RED.native_accounting_off: Real stock writer, solver and FEM result import must complete for this same fixture first.
first_RED.native_accounting_on: Same geometry, material, loads, mesh and ordinary constraint selection; enable native accounting and both cut flags then call stock write_inp_file.
first_RED.expected_ValueError_substring: Selected native accounting support is not a supported analysis constraint.
